annotations.title: Put an image in the post

description: Requires a TechFabric engineer's Microsoft sign-in (scope blog.write). A read: the Markdown for an image already uploaded to your draft, `![alt](name "caption")`, and with markdown the post with it in after the paragraph `after` names (or at the end) and the image rules read on it. Alt text is required (WCAG 2.1): without it, or with one that is the file name, "screenshot", the caption again, under 5 or over 250 characters, it returns the question to ask the engineer and no snippet: never write one yourself. decorative: true, only on the engineer's word, places a decorative image with empty alt. Saves nothing: save the post with update_draft.

after.description: A few words of the paragraph the image goes after; left out, it goes at the end

alt.description: The engineer's own description of what it shows, 5 to 250 characters, not the file name, "screenshot" or the caption (WCAG 2.1); never yours. Refused, with the reason, when it doesn't serve

caption.description: A caption shown under it (optional, at most 140 characters)

decorative.description: true only when the engineer says the image is purely decorative: no alt, no caption, and screen readers skip it

markdown.description: The whole post: returned with the image in, and the image rules read on it

name.description: The image's name, as the upload answered

name: place_image

problem.description: Why the alt text was refused: empty, short, long, filename, generic or caption
